title: GATE — TikTok OAuth token refresh: add /refresh-token Telegram command
rationale: TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN expires and blocks auto-posting. Existing tiktok-refresh-token.ts script does the refresh but has no Telegram interface. Add /refresh-token command: check TIKTOK_REFRESH_TOKEN set, run refresh script, report new expiry time.

tasks.description: Add cmdRefreshToken(chatId) async function to scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-system.ts. Check client creds + refresh token present, run tiktok-refresh-token.ts via execSync, read data/tiktok-token-meta.json, report new expiry to operator.
Add /refresh-token to asyncHandlers in scripts/telegram-bot.ts. Import cmdRefreshToken from cmd-system. Add alias /refreshtoken.
